The Inner Compass

Know what you feel. Choose what comes next.

$12.99 USD · planned launch price

A 30-day guided reflection journal in development for understanding emotions, reconnecting with values and choosing a thoughtful next step. The planned progression gives difficult days and meaningful changes somewhere to land.

Interior previews will be added when the product is ready.

The journal is in development. It supports self-reflection and is not therapy or a crisis service. Interior pages are not yet available.

What's inside.
